15: 
16: > **Conjecture.** The two generating sets for the ideal \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) given in Theorem 5.4 are both minimal.

22: \]
23:

25: 
26: \[
27: \{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}
28: \]

claims.text: If either known \(N\)-element generating family has quotient \(J/\Lambda_+J\cong\mathbb Z^N\), then its image is a \(\mathbb Z\)-basis and the family is minimal.

For \(A=\mathbb Z[x]\), \(\deg x=1\), and \(J=(2x,x^2)\), the homogeneous generating family \((2x,x^2)\) is minimal but \(J/A_+J\cong\mathbb Z\oplus\mathbb Z/2\), so minimality does not imply free integral indecomposables.
